edits: no element edits: the file is already the mark alone on its gradient circle with a tight viewBox
notes: DECISION: Zulip ships three official forms of the mark: this gradient circle with a white Z (zulip-icon-circle.svg, the one the current PNG is, and the desktop/web app icon), a full-bleed gradient square with a white Z (zulip-icon-square.svg, the mobile app's icon in zulip-flutter, downloaded to src2), and the bare gradient Z with no tile (zulip.com's favicon.svg and the org logo's mark, src4). I shipped the circle to keep the current look; the bare gradient Z (downloads/zulip/src4/favicon.svg) also reads on both themes if the reviewer prefers no tile.
license: Zulip brand mark, used nominatively to identify the connected service; trademark rights remain with Zulip.
